content.short: NFTBOOKS uses NFTs to offer affordable and accessible e-books, magazines, articles, literature, and poetry.
content.description: NFTBOOKS uses NFT technology to provide an affordable and accessible range of e-books, magazines, articles, literature, and poetry to readers worldwide. By offering NFT-based ownership and distribution of digital reading materials, the project aims to expand access to a diverse roster of literary works. Readers can discover, collect, and engage with books and content in a modern blockchain-enabled format, broadening how literature is experienced.
